title: Linear saving in exact-order binary Hayes trace layers
statement: Let ell>=200, n in {2ell+1,2ell+2}, and a=ell-ceil(log2 ell)-1. For every a<=j<=ell and every nonempty family X_(j,s) of Hayes characters of exact conductor j and exact order 2^s, 4ell times the absolute signed trace sum over X_(j,s) is at most |X_(j,s)|(j-1)2^ceil(n/2).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact-order orthogonality and endpoint repricing

notes: The native implication proves that this factor-4ell saving, together with proved low-conductor Weil bounds and the degree-400 handoff, settles both Lemire endpoints. Passing bounded Galois-order rows are falsification controls only.
